Class CanBuses

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.hardware.CanBuses
public final class CanBuses extends Object
The CAN buses FM runs on under SystemCore, and the one place a bus name becomes a CANBus.

On the 2026 roboRIO FM had two buses: a CANivore ("*") carrying the drivetrain and most mechanisms, and the roboRIO's own bus ("rio") carrying the intake rollers. SystemCore has no "rio" bus; it has five native CAN FD ports, addressed with CANBus.systemcore(int). A CANivore still works on SystemCore once CTRE's canivore-usb package is installed on it (see wpilibsuite/SystemcoreTesting CTR-Phoenix.md), so the CANivore half of the robot keeps its wiring and only the roboRIO-bus devices move.

Device configs keep carrying bus names (strings) as they did in 2026. forName(String) resolves SYSTEMCORE_PREFIXn to CANBus.systemcore(n) and anything else to a CANivore by name.

Check against the wiring before the event: USE_CANIVORE and the port of each group.

    • USE_CANIVORE

      public static final boolean USE_CANIVORE
      Whether FM runs its CANivore. true is the 2026 wiring: drivetrain and most mechanisms on the CANivore, intake rollers on SystemCore port 0. false spreads everything over the SystemCore's native ports instead (see DRIVETRAIN, SHOOTER, MECHANISMS); no "*" bus is ever opened.
